description: Calculates indicative prices for up to twenty products for the company with this CVR, from one flat `answers` object. A plain key answers a question for the company and for every selected product that asks it; `<product>.<name>` answers one product's question. Stored answers and company discounts are not reused; supply required answers explicitly. An optional partnerCode applies that partner's discount. Enum fields use {value, label: {da, en}}. Each product has a status.value: only `quoted` products have a price; `contactPlain` products need an individual offer from Plain and `unavailable` ones cannot be offered (see `issue`). Prices are in DKK (major units) per billingFrequency.value period, with annualPrice for comparison and totals across products. State prices with each quote's `display` text in the customer's language, and always show the `disclaimer`. When pricePerEmployee is true, the price is per employee: say so using the quote's notice, as the customer selects the covered employees on Plain. Unknown answer keys are ignored and reported in warnings; required answers are never inferred. Nothing is bound, created or charged. Works without signing in, as a public new-company quote. Quotes for an existing customer must use the selected, authorized company's CVR. Active products return status.value alreadyInsured with no new-offer price and are excluded from totals and creation; held prerequisites do not need to be selected again. Check list_companies.canCreateOffers before promising to create offers. Quoting itself only needs policies:read. For existing companies, use get_onboarding_payment_link after creating offers for authenticated review; continueUrl is the public new-company signup page and does not apply private policy exclusions.

inputSchema.description: The company, products and answers to price. Send the same object again in /start.

additionalProperties.description: The answer's JSON type follows the catalog question's `type.value`: Text is a string; NumberWhole is an integer and NumberDecimal a number (numeric strings are accepted); Date is a YYYY-MM-DD string; Boolean is true or false; Select is one option key from `options` as a string; MultiSelect is an array of option keys.

answers.description: Every answer in one object, keyed by the catalog question `name`. A plain name answers that question for the company and for every selected product that asks it; `<product>.<name>` (e.g. loesoereforsikring.basement) answers only that product's question and takes precedence. Employee FTE questions are answered as `<name>.fullTime` and `<name>.partTime` head counts: integers from 0 to 9999 inclusive. When required, send both counts explicitly, including zero.

cvr.description: Danish company registration number (CVR), eight digits, e.g. 39488914.

partnerCode.description: Optional partner discount code, 2-64 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores. Must be active.

products.description: The products to quote: 1 to 20 distinct slugs, including any products they require.

region.description: Market. Only Denmark (dk) is supported. Optional; defaults to dk.

startDate.description: Policy start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today. Must be between today and one year ahead.

name: quote_onboarding_products

outputSchema.description: Indicative prices. Nothing is bound or charged.

continueUrl.description: Where the customer reviews this quote on Plain and continues to sign up. Opening it creates nothing.

disclaimer.description: Show with the prices: they are indicative, and nothing binds until the customer signs on Plain.

expiresAt.description: Until when quoteId can be used for /start, unless prices change first; then request a new quote.

quoteId.description: Identifies these prices; pass it as `quoteId` to /start with the exact original quote request. Only quoted products become offers. Null when no product is quoted.

quotes.description: One quote per selected product, in request order.

items.description: The indicative price of one product, or why it has none.

annualPrice.description: The price per year, to compare monthly and annual products; present when quoted.

fees.description: Statutory fees and taxes per billing period, in DKK.

premium.description: Insurance premium per billing period, in DKK.

totalPrice.description: What the customer pays per billing period, in DKK (major units, kroner): premium plus government fees.

billingFrequency.description: How often the customer pays: Monthly or Annual. Prices are per period of this frequency.

coverage.description: What the price buys. Fields are null when the product does not state them.

summary.description: What the insurance covers, in brief.

display.description: How to state this quote to the customer: total, premium and fees split, and period.

issue.description: Why the product is not quoted.

allowedValues.description: For invalid_answer on a select question: the option keys that are accepted.

code.description: Error code and its translated labels.

idempotency_conflict.da: Idempotensnøglen er allerede brugt til andre oplysninger
idempotency_conflict.en: Idempotency key already used for different input

didYouMean.description: Suggested catalog product slug or answer key. Retry only after confirming the intended value.

field.description: Request field to correct, using dot notation for nested fields.

max.description: Inclusive maximum: the latest start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for invalid_start_date, or the numeric upper bound for invalid_answer.

min.description: Inclusive minimum: the earliest start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for invalid_start_date, or the numeric lower bound for invalid_answer.

nextAction.description: What to do next: fixAnswer (correct the request and retry), askUser (ask the person for new input or to sign in), retryLater (retry the same request later), contactPlain (Plain must review this case; refer the person to Plain), none (nothing to do).

askUser.da: Bed kunden om oplysninger eller login
askUser.en: Ask the customer for input or to sign in

fixAnswer.en: Correct the request and try again

product.description: Slug of the product the error concerns, when it concerns one.

question.description: Answer key of the question the error concerns, as used in `answers`.

questionLabel.description: Danish question label, when the question can be identified in the catalog.

da.description: Danish question label from the catalog.

reason.description: For price_unavailable: industry_not_covered when the product has no tariff for the company's industry, otherwise unknown.

name.description: Product name to show next to the price.

notice.description: A message to show the customer with this price, e.g. that it is per employee.

price.description: The price per billing period; present when quoted.

fees.description: Statutory fees and taxes per billing period, in DKK.

premium.description: Insurance premium per billing period, in DKK.

totalPrice.description: What the customer pays per billing period, in DKK (major units, kroner): premium plus government fees.

pricePerEmployee.description: Whether `price` is per covered employee. The customer selects the employees when purchasing on Plain, which sets the total.

status.description: quoted: priced and can be sent to /start. contactPlain: Plain makes an individual offer; the customer contacts Plain. unavailable: cannot be offered for these answers; see `issue`. alreadyInsured: active for the authorized company; excluded from new offers and totals. Only quoted products have a price.

ipidPdf.description: Insurance product information document (IPID) as PDF. Give this link to the customer.

ipidYaml.description: The IPID as YAML, for agents to read the key facts: what is and is not covered, restrictions and obligations.

termsMarkdown.description: Full insurance terms as Markdown, for agents to read and answer questions about coverage.

termsPdf.description: Full insurance terms as PDF. Give this link to the customer.

termsDocuments.description: Links to the product's terms documents, or null when it has none. Read the YAML and Markdown to answer questions; give the customer the PDF links. External terms use the same link for all four.

termsUrl.description: Link to the product's insurance terms as PDF. Same as `termsDocuments.termsPdf`.

startDate.description: The insurance start date the prices apply to; today when the request has none.

fees.description: Statutory fees and taxes per billing period, in DKK.

premium.description: Insurance premium per billing period, in DKK.

totalPrice.description: What the customer pays per billing period, in DKK (major units, kroner): premium plus government fees.

display.description: How to state the totals to the customer.

excludedProducts.description: Selected products not in the totals: not quoted, or priced per employee.

monthly.description: Sum per month; annual products count as a twelfth of their yearly price.

fees.description: Statutory fees and taxes per billing period, in DKK.

premium.description: Insurance premium per billing period, in DKK.

totalPrice.description: What the customer pays per billing period, in DKK (major units, kroner): premium plus government fees.

totals.description: Totals of the quoted products; null when no product is included.

warnings.description: Non-fatal problems with ignored answers. Omitted when there are none.

code.description: An unrecognized answer key was ignored; no answer was inferred from it.

didYouMean.description: Suggested answer key. Confirm it before resending; answers are never auto-corrected.

question.description: The ignored answer key. Check the catalog for the correct name.

questionLabel.description: Danish label of the suggested question, when available.

da.description: Danish question label from the catalog.
